what_is_not_verified: Sample firm identity and sample years
Number of meetings/investors or effect size
Trading timing variable construction, transactions/costs and holding horizons
Identification strategy, estimates, controls and robustness
Any causal mechanism or private material information delivery
Japanese listed firms, individual email/form IR, response rates or reply-state likelihoods
Implementable excess return or any buy/sell rule
possible_design_questions_only_not_adopt: Distinguish contact medium and participant type: senior-management one-to-one meeting versus individual written IR question.
Record firm/investor/question selection and public-information availability; a contacted group cannot automatically be compared causally with an uncontacted group.
Separate communication receipt, interpretation, independent later state evidence and executed investment outcome. Existing observation policy remains unchanged.
Treat author abstract mosaic interpretation as a hypothesis to test, not evidence that all nonpublic contact improves forecasts.
